title: Yunikorn k8shim: go-ntlmssp is a Go package that provides NTLM/Negotiate authentication over HTTP (CVE-2026-32952)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-32952) affects the yunikorn-k8shim package versions prior to 1.8.0-r4. The issue involves the go-ntlmssp Go package, which provides NTLM/Negotiate authentication over HTTP. The vulnerability has no impact on confidentiality or integrity but causes a denial of service (availability impact). A fix is available in version 1.8.0-r4.
